caption: The image is a finely detailed black-and-white pencil drawing of a teapot centered within a rectangular border on a slightly yellowed piece of paper. The teapot features a round, bulbous body that narrows at the neck before flaring out slightly to form a flat, wide rim. The lid of the teapot is dome-shaped with a small, round knob on top. The spout is curved and extends widely from the left side of the body, while the handle on the right is large and ornately shaped with multiple curves and a slight flourish at the ends. The teapot is set on a broad, rounded pedestal base. The shading throughout the drawing is stippled and graded, giving the object volume and a metallic appearance. In the lower right-hand corner, below the border, the name “Hettington Campbell” is written in a delicate script. The entire composition is monochromatic, composed of various tones of gray on an off-white background.
title: Pewter Teapot
